title: Activity derived metric
description: A named workload, training-effect, peak, or performance metric derived from an activity.

unit.description: The canonical unit symbol, or null for a dimensionless value.

durationSeconds.description: The duration window in seconds for peak or interval metrics.

distanceMeters.description: The distance window in meters for distance-based performance metrics.

metadata.description: Additional structured context specific to the metric type.

source.description: The system that supplied or calculated this metric.

algorithm.description: The stable identifier of the calculation or source metric family.

algorithmVersion.description: The calculation version, or legacy-unversioned when historical records predate explicit versioning.

calculatedAt.description: The time the metric was calculated in ISO 8601 format.
